candidats.description: Manual metal arc welding steel connections on deck

The New Linz Danube Bridge (project name) is the replacement of the railway bridge dismantled in 2016. It was built according to a design by the Paris architecture firm Mimram. The connection between the steel structure and the concrete road surface is accomplished by welded-on bolts .

candidats.description: Lance Cpl. Zachary Graybill, a motor transport mechanic with 1st Battalion, 2nd Marine Regiment, welds a metal drum used to store hazardous materials aboard Camp Leatherneck, Helmand province, Afghanistan, July 11, 2014. Graybill, a native of Duncannon, Pennsylvania, is one of the mechanics responsible for ensuring vehicles run properly and effectively in order to complete the mission for coalition forces serving with Regional Command (Southwest).
